data.title: FizzBuzz
data.statement:
Given an integer [[N]], print the numbers from 1 to [[N]] using these rules:

    Multiples of 3 become Fizz.
    Multiples of 5 become Buzz.
    Multiples of both become FizzBuzz.
    All other numbers stay unchanged.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Given an integer N, print the numbers from 1 to N using these rules:

Multiples of 3 become Fizz.
Multiples of 5 become Buzz.
Multiples of both become FizzBuzz.
All other numbers stay unchanged.
Input
Line 1: An integer N.
Output
Line 1: The values from 1 to N, separated by spaces, after applying the rules.
Constraints
1 ≤ N ≤ 1000
Example
Input
1
Output
1
